title: The Landstar Link Newsletter, Winter 2024
summary: The Winter 2024 Landstar Link Newsletter is now available!
body_markdown:
## The Winter 2024 edition of The Landstar Link newsletter is now available!


This issue features…


- A welcome to new President and CEO Frank Lonegro
- Landstar BCO Jay Hosty named *Overdrive* magazine's Driver of the Year 2023
- Landstar breaks ground on a new field operations center


All this and more as we launch into the new year!


[Read The Landstar Link, Winter 2024](https://cloud.3dissue.net/29953/29847/30285/106561/index.html)
